newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Two kidnapped Europeans freed in Colombia.
newsitem.headline: Two kidnapped Europeans freed in Colombia.

text.p: Two kidnapped Europeans were freed by police in the northwest city of Medellin, officials said on Thursday.

Spanish engineer Rafael Sanchez Carbonell, 44, of Valencia, was kidnapped in Bogota in mid-December. The other man, construction engineer Sergio Ruiz Lama, 29, of Liege, Belgium, was snatched in Medellin in mid-January.

A police spokesman said agents of the specialist GAULA squad rescued the men late on Wednesday and captured five members of the kidnap gang, believed to be common criminals. The gang had been demanding $200,000 ransom for the pair.

Colombia is the kidnap capital of the world. Last year there were more than 1,400 reported abductions -- more than half attributed to leftist guerrillas who allegedly fill their war chests with ransom payments.
